ET.time_support: 86400-second interval mean, numerically equal to daily mm
ET.limitation: EPD excluded as requested; native EIC includes canopy reset accounting

soil_moisture.basis: Water mass per bulk soil volume; constant water density 1000 kg m-3

GPP.source_logic: wofost.f90 PGASS=DTGA*30*(0.4/CFRDM)/44, then management and stress reductions retained in GASS; CSV GASST=IGASS reset at output interval
GPP.missing: NaN for prescribed vegetation; retain GASST_flag; no active dynamic crop values remain documented zero
GPP.limitations: Model gross assimilation equivalent retains RELMF; not observed GPP or complete ecosystem GPP

soil_temperature.time_support: Day end state at actual compartment centre

temporal_comparison: Full 2024 and 2025; 2026 partial. April 1 through September 30 provides 183 days in each year. No long-term climatological classification.
